name: Disk Cleanup
summary: See what Claude Code, Codex and agent runs left on disk: transcripts, scratchpads, worktrees, build trees, sandboxes and caches, what each is attached to, and delete what nothing uses through git and guarded deletes.

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

permissions.label: Measure Claude Code, Codex, worktree, build and temp folders in your home and temp folders
Read which local processes have a folder open, so nothing in use is offered for deletion
See which agent sessions, task work items and repositories reference a worktree
Delete the files and folders you confirm, through the guarded delete helper
Remove confirmed worktrees with git and move retired branches to a trash ref
Run ccache to evict compiler cache entries unused for 14 days when you ask

screenshots.alt: The Disk Cleanup page: categories with totals, items with size, age, a status chip and what each is attached to, and Delete selected
